scope_and_limitations: Standard focused U/A/P/O audit against dashboard/README.md. Expert source review, real app handlers in Node VM with controlled DOM/fetch, Python in-memory HTTP handler checks, clean-copy startup attempts. No real browser: Chrome launch exit 134; no browser MCP/automation. Socket bind denied by sandbox. No screenshots, rendered accessibility/geometry, AT, text zoom, real keyboard, Chrome input-to-frame samples, field CWV, user sessions, load or production assurance. Source hashes identify builds; repository has no HEAD. Protected README startup-path failure remains proposed. Patched layout/performance failures remain verification pending at original severity until browser recheck.
